meta.units: mm, deg; frame M unless a key says B or unreal

frames.M: +X muzzle, +Z up, +Y gun left; X 0 butt-pad rear, Z 0 bore

real.pattern: .308-class bolt-action chassis rifle (short action, 22 in heavy fluted barrel)

anchors.source: 34 mm tube class (30 mm would give 970 mm, 36 mm 1165 mm)

parts.display: Chassis (centre + forend, integral guard, mag well, dovetail band)
parts.bevel: outer edges 0.6 mm 45 deg chamfer (>= rear visibility minimum 0.4); inside pocket corners keep the cutter radius 3.0 mm; slot edges 0.4
parts.construction: One-piece machined chassis from the butt interface (X 150 px ~ X 244) to the forend front (X 836.8): action bed with a full-length bolt raceway (radius 12.5 at Z 0, open on top between X 345 and 567), an inletted receiver pocket, integral mag well (walls 3.0, clearance 0.3 to the mag, catch window at the rear, top shelf at Z -11.5), trigger-housing pocket, integral guard bosses, and the forend tube (U-section, wall 3.5) free-floating around the barrel with >= 3.0 radial clearance. The drawn panel recess on the action side (X ~455-560, both sides) is a 0.8 mm deep pocket with 3 mm corner radius. Three slots per side (X 662-698, 715-752, 768-811; Z -12.9..-3.5) cut through the forend wall with 0.4 chamfers; these are an original slot pattern (never named after a trade standard). Bottom of the forend: an integral plain dovetail band X 582-831 (the drawn lower band), 38 mm across, 45 deg flanks, no slots (none drawn).
key_features: bolt raceway is real geometry: the bolt slides 88 mm back in it
mag well walls, shelf and catch window modelled (form stage)
no seam drawn between centre and forend: one part
action-bed screw heads only where drawn
parts.authority: GR (outline, slots); TOP (widths x2 left half)

parts.bevel: 0.6 chamfer outer; 2.5 radius at the cut-out's inside corners
parts.construction: Fixed skeleton-style butt bolted to the chassis at X ~244 (a 0.3 mm visible seam with depth 0.5, the only joint drawn). Profile = the traced 'butt' part: flat top Z -16.7 (riser seat), lower edge rising from the heel step to the grip, rear vertical slab X 57-100 px with a stepped lower heel. The two drawn round heads (X 99 / 129, Z -67.5, dia 15) are the length-of-pull/ butt-height clamp knobs (knurled cap, 2 mm proud). Riser post bores (2x dia 10) in the top face.
key_features: hinge not drawn: fixed (R6)
heel step as drawn
two clamp knobs on the right only (GL draws a rectangular QD-cup recess at X ~110-135 instead)
parts.authority: GR; GL for its QD-cup recess

parts.construction: LOP spacer plate X 52.9-68.9 between the butt and the pad, three socket-head screws (dia 6 / 8.3 / 6 drawn heads at Z -26, -69, -103) on the right; real pattern: 4 mm thread socket caps in counterbores.
key_features: screw heads from the sheet (>= 4 px for the middle one)

parts.bevel: R 3.0-4.0 on the outer edges, R 1.5 on the face ribs
parts.construction: Thick recoil pad X 0-52.9, Z -153.7..16.4 (170 tall), width 61 (TOP left half x 2), rounded rectangle section; three horizontal moulded grooves on the side faces as drawn (0.8 deep); rear face flat with a faint stipple (normal only); slight draft 1.5 deg.
key_features: rubber never shows metal
toe and heel abraded (R)

parts.process: M-chamfer (machined aluminium plate on two steel posts)
parts.bevel: 0.6 chamfer; plate's lower front corner chamfer 6 x 45 as drawn
parts.construction: Plate X 68.9-179.9, top Z 32.0, bottom Z -3.5 (35.5 thick), width 69 (TOP); a shallow cheek dish 1.5 mm on its left top (unseen, real pattern; plain if Q-free). Two posts dia 10 at X ~95 and ~150 into bores in the butt's top (sliding clearance 0.15-0.40); a clamp lever on the left side of the butt (GL draws a small dark lever at X ~95, Z -10). Height: sheet pose = rest; travel -12.9..+12.0 mm (plate bottom 0.3 above the butt top at the low stop).
key_features: exposed post length at rest 13.2 mm (drawn)
cheek-weld wear on the left top (G)

parts.display: Receiver (round, short action) with port and lug recesses
parts.construction: Round receiver dia 34.3 (real short-action class), X 382-567, axis = bore; ejection port on the right X 422.5-507.1, Z 4.9-14.3 (drawn) opened to the real port shape (cut to the bolt raceway, wall 3.0 visible); bolt-handle notch at the rear bridge right (the handle root drops into it when closed: 60 deg cam slope); recoil lug ring at the front under the chassis; the integral scope base rail screwed on top (separate part 'rail').
key_features: port interior and bolt face revealed when open
rear tang on the right carries the safety
bolt stop on the left rear, hidden in the chassis (not animated, R11)

dims.lug_recesses: 3 x 60 deg at the front ring, 12 deep

parts.construction: Scope base X 385.8-546.6 (160.8), top Z 30.0, built by gunlib rail_1913 with 15 slots at 10.01 centred (end webs ~5.4); flat (0 MOA: the drawn scope axis is parallel to the bore within 0.06 deg); 4 button-head screws in slots 1, 5, 9, 13 (dia 4.8 heads inside the 5.24 slots, SMG C13 lesson).
key_features: drawn tooth pitch 10.6 mm: built at 10.01 (line standard)
Rail_Top = centre of slot 0

parts.bevel: 0.3 on lugs, 0.8 round on the shroud's rear edge

joint.also: lugs in recesses hinge row 0.10-0.30 during the 60 deg turn

parts.construction: Bolt body dia 17.8 from the face X 505 back to the shroud; three locking lugs at 120 deg (OD 25.4, 12 long) at the front: they ride in the raceway's lug grooves and lock into the receiver ring's lug recesses (modelled: 3 recesses cut 60 deg wide); recessed bolt face with an extractor hook (right) and plunger ejector hole; shroud X 345.4-380 (drawn: dia ~24, rear dome); cocking indicator tip at the shroud rear (plain). Real pattern: 3-lug 60 deg throw.
key_features: rotate 60 deg, then slide 88 mm (clip BoltCycle)
polished sliding flanks (R forced)
bolt face visible through the open port

parts.bevel: stem 0.8 round; knob is a revolve

Y of the knob from TOP (right edge -85.0 less the 5 mm shadow bias, less the radius).
key_features: TOP draws the knob 32 mm further back than GR: GR wins X, TOP gives Y
clears the scope by >= 20 mm open and back (S0 check)

parts.construction: Two-position rocker on the right receiver tang behind the bolt handle (real 2-position tang pattern): lever 14 long x 5 wide x 4 thick, serrated thumb face (geometry: 4 ridges at 1.2 pitch), pivot at X 360.0, Z -16.0 on a transverse pin; FIRE = forward (bind), SAFE = 12 deg rearward. thumb-travel scratch arc (G)

parts.construction: Curved blade X 348.2-385.8 (traced), face X 363.2 at mid height; pivot inside the trigger housing above the blade at X 368, Z -57; pull 0..+6 deg (lower end rearward; 3 mm at the finger, precision trigger). parts.construction: Paddle in front of the trigger guard (real chassis pattern): drawn X 408.4-415.9, Z -71..-114. Built: pivot pin dia 3 at X 410.5, Z -78.0 (clevis in the guard's front leg); catch hook 24 above the pivot at Z -54 engaging the mag's rear-wall notch by 1.4 mm; finger pad 36 below the pivot; front face at rest 0.3 behind... see spec mag_release for the derived numbers (gap to the mag, press angle, hook travel). Push the pad forward = release.

hook travel > engagement (S0 check)

parts.bevel: R 1.5-2.5, draft 1.5 deg, parting line on the mid-plane

parts.bevel: 0.3 flute edges; crown chamfer 45 deg x 1.0

joint.note: threaded into the receiver; >= 3.0 radial clearance to the forend

parts.construction: Breech X 505.5 to crown X 1064.5 (559 mm, 22 in): heavy contour, 35.2 at the forend front tapering to 31.8 at the device (both side views; TOP inflates round parts +6-10 %); 6 straight flutes (3 visible per side as drawn), 6.0 wide x 2.0 deep with 1.0 radius bottoms, X 841-1036 (drawn flute span), run-outs as ball-end cutter exits (no knife edges, UD2); plain shank ahead of the flutes X 1036-1049.7; thread tenon dia 15.9 x 15 under the device; bore 7.8 dia >= 2 calibres deep with darkening.

48 sides LOD0 (G3)
free-floated: >= 3.0 radial gap to the forend

parts.bevel: front chamfer 2.0 x 45 as drawn; rear collar step 0.5
parts.construction: Linear compensator (closed outer sleeve, no side ports drawn): X 1049.7-1100, OD 36.1 (side), rear collar step at X ~1052, front face with an exit bore 12 mm (3/4 view), internal baffle + forward vent ring behind the face (hidden; visible only down the exit). Threads on the tenon (hidden).

soot gradient at the exit

parts.bevel: body bends inside R 1.0; cut edges 0.25; floorplate R 1.0
parts.construction: Straight double-stack 10-round box, vertical (sheet rake -0.9 / +1.3 deg: built 0.0), fore-aft 89.3, thickness 26.5 (unseen except 3/4; real .308 double stack 25.5-27.5), top at Z -11.0 under the bolt, well-entry Z -68.8, bottom Z -132.3 (exposed 63.5). Two pressed vertical ribs per side (as drawn in the 3/4, 0.8 proud), feed lips (single-feed, real pattern) with the top round modelled, follower; rear wall notch for the catch at Z -54; floorplate 2.0 thicker than the body with a 1.5 overhang front and back.

insertion straight along -Z
spine and floorplate corner wear (R)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 3-lug, 60 deg throw, 88 mm stroke, bolt face X 505 at rest
real_pattern_rulings.why: the knob's rest angle (26 deg below horizontal) lifted 60 deg reaches 34 deg above horizontal: clears a 34 mm scope's eyepiece by > 20 mm; 88 mm clears a .308-class cartridge (71 mm) plus extraction; the port (84.6 drawn) is opened to 88 + 2

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: swept stem, spherical knob dia 24.8 (sheet), screw-on with a thread-relief groove
real_pattern_rulings.why: sheet size; real tactical knobs 20-25 mm; GR authority for X, TOP for Y

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: single-stage precision trigger, pivot above the blade, 6 deg pull; guard integral with the chassis
real_pattern_rulings.why: chassis rifles carry the guard in the chassis bottom; no seam drawn

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 2-position tang rocker on the right, behind the bolt handle; FIRE forward (bind), SAFE 12 deg back
real_pattern_rulings.why: real pattern for this action class; not resolved on the sheet

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: paddle in front of the trigger guard, push forward; hook 24 above the pivot, pad 36 below
real_pattern_rulings.why: drawn where real chassis paddles sit; leverage chosen so a 3 mm pad press lifts the hook 2.0 mm (> 1.4 engagement)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: straight 10-round double-stack steel box, vertical, 26.5 thick, two pressed ribs per side, polymer floorplate
real_pattern_rulings.why: exposed length 63.5 = a 10-round box; ribs drawn in the 3/4

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 1913 base 15 slots flat; 34 mm two-piece rings (medium, centre 27.6 above the rail top), each with a recoil lug in a slot and two cross-bolt nuts on the left, 4 cap screws on top (2 per cap)
real_pattern_rulings.why: drawn ring height and tube; rings belong to the scope attachment

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: two steel posts dia 10, clamp lever on the left of the butt, travel -12.9..+12.0
real_pattern_rulings.why: drawn posts exposed 13.2 mm; GL draws a small lever

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: fixed butt; LOP by spacer plate (no bone); two clamp knobs on the right as drawn
real_pattern_rulings.why: no hinge or slide drawn; the brief's 'folding-style' look is kept as shape only (R6)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: tension-swivel folding bipod on a dovetail clamp; independent legs on transverse pins at the hub (X 719.6, Z -61.8), detents 0 / +90 deg; telescoping inner legs 0..76 mm in 5 notches; swivel cant +-15 deg with the drawn rear knob as the tension knob
real_pattern_rulings.why: the drawn hub, knob, collar and spool feet are this pattern; the folded pose is the side views'

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: internal, left rear, not animated; no bone
real_pattern_rulings.why: not drawn; no visible function needed

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: linear compensator, closed sleeve, exit bore 12 mm
real_pattern_rulings.why: no ports drawn; front hole visible in the 3/4; brief: 'simple cylindrical muzzle cap'

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 6 straight flutes 6.0 x 2.0, radius bottoms, ball-end run-outs, X 841-1036
real_pattern_rulings.why: 3 visible per side in the side views; run-outs avoid needle triangles (UD2)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 3 slots per side cut through the wall (original pattern, never named after a standard); bottom band = plain dovetail, no 1913 teeth
real_pattern_rulings.why: drawn without teeth; Rail_Bottom not offered (the bipod uses it)

real_pattern_rulings.ruling: 34 mm tube, 56 mm-class objective, elevation turret on top, windage on the right, parallax/side-focus on the left, magnification ring + throw lever at the eyepiece; rubber eyecup ring
real_pattern_rulings.why: TOP shows the left knob larger than the right turret; brief: rubber eye cup

wear_logic: Painted aluminium chips at corners to a dark rim then metal (R); hand zones polish the paint (G: grip top, comb/riser left top, forend belly, bolt knob, safety arc); the bolt body is polished bare by sliding; the bipod feet, butt toe/heel and mag floorplate corners are abraded (R); dust in rail slots, forend slots and pocket corners (B); soot at the device exit and the port.

gates.S0: this file: 0 missing fields, 0 failed consistency/clearance checks (validator output in S0)

look.L1: blockout IoU GR >= 0.95, GL >= 0.95, TOP >= 0.92; < 0.90 = stop and change the method
look.L2: form IoU GR >= 0.96 (authority), GL >= 0.958 (sheet self-IoU - 0.01), TOP >= 0.93; each part on GR >= 0.95 (areas in parts[].trace); Q34 camera-solved IoU >= 0.93, contour P95 <= 3 px, folded bipod pose
look.L3: P95 contour <= 2 sheet px (3.8 mm); features <= 2 px; declared: paddle front face, ring positions (integer slots), knob X from GR only, TOP feet width
look.L5: colour vs sheet crops (OD 89,89,78 rendered; stone S16 tolerances)
look.L7: blind design judge >= 12 pairs (<= 8/12) REPORTED, not blocking (user rule); 2 realism judges on FP 35 cm, scope view, TP 3 m, hero 3/4 + bipod deployed hero: decide the look
look.L8: early realism per part group at form (chassis, bolt group, bipod, scope): PASS = <= 1 single-judge fake call per group; both judges = decisive fail, stop

blender.B1-B11: as the SMG plan (skeleton, rigid skin, sweeps, sockets, sidecar, twin, geometry, budgets, textures, names, bounds over every LOD)

blender.B4: no iron sights: B4 = scope sight line (Sight on the tube axis, parallel to the bore <= 0.05 deg) with the attachment mounted

resolutions.ruling: The sheet's LEFT/RIGHT labels are swapped. The panel labelled LEFT shows the gun's RIGHT (bolt handle and knob; muzzle image-right); TOP has the knob image-down = right (muzzle image-right); the 3/4 FRONT RIGHT shows the knob. Panels renamed GR / GL in every tool.

Overall 1100 mm (not the study table's 1270, an AWM-class .338 figure). The user asked for a .308-class chassis rifle; the sheet's own anchors give 1049 mm median (spread [998, 1151]) and the strongest one, the 34 mm scope tube (18.1 px on both sides), gives 1097. At 1270 the tube would be 39 mm (no such class) and the barrel 37 mm thick. 1100 sits in the class range 1050-1200.

Barrel 559 mm (22 in): breech X 505.5 (bolt face at the drawn port's front), crown X 1064.5 inside the device (seat X 1049.7); the sheet geometry and the real figure agree. Mass 5.9 kg without scope and mag (bipod included), scope + rings 1.15 kg, ready 7.5 kg.
Direction: the barrel's straight top edge (rms 0.13 px) and the scope tube (rms 0.05 px) agree within 0.06 deg; height: the device centre line (GR and GL agree to 0.01 px).

Side views AND the 3/4 show the bipod FOLDED (legs forward under the forend, feet side by side ahead of the clamp). The study's 'deployed in the 3/4' is wrong: no deployed view exists. Folded pose = GR/GL authority and a second camera-solved check on the 3/4; deployed pose = the real pattern (legs straight down).
Fixed: no hinge, fold seam or latch is resolvable on any view; the brief's 'folding-style' look is kept as shape only (no stock bone). Open Q4.

Tension-swivel folding bipod: legs on transverse pins at the drawn hub (X 719.6, Z -62.3), Y +-19.5, independent, detents 0/+90; ext 0..76 in 19 mm notches; cant +-15 about X at Z -46.0; the drawn knob below the hub is the swivel-tension knob. Bore height deployed 268.3..344.3 mm.
3-lug 60 deg throw then 88 mm stroke; knob (X 367.9, Y -67.6, Z -33.6) lifts to Z 41.7; it clears the mounted scope by 29.9 mm over the whole cycle.
TOP draws the knob 32 mm further back than GR; GR gives X and Z, TOP gives the knob's outboard reach (right edge less the 5 mm shadow bias).
TOP right-side edges read 4-6 mm wide (soft floor shadow); symmetric widths = 2 x the left half-width; TOP inflates round parts 6-10 %: diameters from the side views.
Straight, vertical (drawn -0.9/+1.3 deg), fore-aft 89.3, thickness 26.5 (unseen; real class), 10 rounds, top Z -11.0, insertion straight along Z; Mag at well entry [458.7, 0.0, -68.8].
Forward-push paddle; built front face X 410.6, 3.4 mm behind the drawn edge (declared, < 2 sheet px), hook 24.0 above the pivot travels 1.88 > engagement 1.4; pad keeps 0.36 to the mag at full press.
The brief says 'vertical pistol grip'; the sheet draws straps at 30.7 / 24.9 deg (axis 27.15). The sheet wins (silhouette rule).
Scope base built with rail_1913, 15 slots at 10.01 (drawn pitch 10.61), flat (0 MOA); rings on slots [2, 12] (shift [2.6, -1.65] mm from the drawn ring centres).
Separate attachment SM_Att_Scope_LongRange (scope + rings) on Rail_Top + 2 slots, own Sight/EyePoint, body + lens slots; the gun carries no Sight socket and no iron sights (none drawn).

Gun: 2 slots (Metal on M_Steel_Master; Chassis on M_Fabric_Master + Metal From ORM with rubber/polymer/anodized parts at Masks A 0) so the twin holds Metal 0 / Chassis 1 / merged mag -1 = the qa_check 3-tile limit; held draws 10 incl. the scope.

Adjustable: bone cheek_riser, travel [-12.9, 12.0] mm from the sheet pose (posts exposed 13.2 drawn); parent body pending gunlib proposal P1. ADS eye point (X 176.1) sits over the riser; riser top 25.6 mm below the scope axis.
Plain dovetail (no teeth drawn), the bipod clamp's seat; no Rail_Bottom socket in v1.
2-position tang rocker on the right behind the handle (bone selector; FIRE bind, SAFE -12); real pattern, not resolved on the sheet.
Linear compensator (closed sleeve, 12 mm exit), bone muzzle_device, hidden for the universal suppressor at MuzzleSeat.
Legs at Y +-19.5 with 37 mm feet (side-view size) span 76 mm in TOP where TOP reads ~60: declared; the feet keep a 2.0 mm gap.
Cant is allowed only when deployed if the folded check fails (folded worst 7.73 mm, deployed 32.41 mm).
